first_step_test: A tall rounded housing and its lower neck create a recognizable signal silhouette and locate every later lamp within one fixed frame.

source.notes: Six-panel handmade marker-on-paper contact sheet; rejected iterations stay in drafts.

frames.visible_job: Draw one tall rounded housing with an attached short lower neck.
frames.instruction: Ghost the tall housing curve twice, then pull its rounded left and right sides in confident black marker strokes. Close the top and bottom around a short centered neck; leave its interior blank for three lamps.

frames.visible_job: Draw three separate aligned circular lamps inside the housing.
frames.instruction: Fit one round lamp near the top, one in the middle, and one near the bottom, leaving similar side margins. Compare the empty gaps between circles before inking the second and third rings.

frames.visible_job: Add one short curved visor above each existing ring.
frames.instruction: Pull a short curved hood across the top edge of each lamp ring, letting its ends tuck into the housing. Keep the lower halves of the three circles open and visible.

frames.visible_job: Extend the neck into a narrow post and flat foot.
frames.instruction: Continue the short neck straight down into a narrow post, then widen it into one flat rounded base. Keep the post centered under the housing so the signal does not lean.

frames.visible_job: Add two small bolts, one green-lamp shine gap, and a broken base shadow.
frames.instruction: Place one tiny bolt on each lower housing side, leave a small crescent gap inside the bottom lamp for shine, and draw a short broken shadow directly beneath the base. Keep all three lamp rings distinct.

final_step.visible_job: Color existing top red, middle amber, bottom green, housing teal, post navy, and shadow cool gray with visible marker strokes.
final_step.instruction: Fill the top lamp red, middle lamp amber, and bottom lamp vivid green around its reserved shine gap. Pull teal marker strokes down the housing and navy down the post, letting the paper texture show; reinforce only established black contours.
